description: Makes a QR code as scalable SVG (21x21 modules, version 1) for up to 17 bytes at level L, 14 at M, 11 at Q or 7 at H, with the mask chosen by the standard penalty rules. Returns the SVG and a base64 copy. Larger versions are not supported; longer text returns 400. Choose this tool for: Makes a QR code as scalable SVG for up to 17 bytes at level. Close alternatives on this server: agent_intel_global_postal_geocode_resolver (Resolves a postal code in one country to its place names); agent_intel_agent_json_schema_guard (Checks an agent's JSON output against a JSON Schema). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

ec.description: Error correction level: L, M, Q or H (default M)

scale.description: Pixels per module in the SVG, 1 to 20 (default 8)

text.description: Text to encode as UTF-8 bytes; the byte limit depends on the level
